kind.value: Social media management software built on a marketing calendar, with publishing, a social inbox, analytics and campaign and project planning

hosting.value: Hosted (no self-host option on its pricing page)

pricingModel.value: A flat tier plus metered extras: each plan includes a number of seats and social profiles, with $5 a month for each extra profile and $29 a month for an extra seat on Professional. X profiles are excluded from the base plans and billed at $16 each a month

freeOption.value: Free plan: up to 15 posts scheduled at a time on 1 profile

trial.value: 14-day trial on Starter and Professional, but a card is required: you pick a plan and enter a card, are not charged until it ends, and can cancel to the free plan before then. Suite starts with a demo

entryPaid.value: Starter, $39/month on monthly billing, 1 seat and 3 social profiles

plans.value: Starter $39 a month (1 seat, 3 profiles) and Professional $59 (2 seats, up to 3 users, 5 profiles) on monthly billing; Suite is custom from $69. Add-ons: $5 a month an extra profile, $29 an extra user on Professional, $16 an X profile
plans.note: The page opens on annual billing, where Starter and Professional show $29 and $49.

3.note: Starter includes 3 profiles. If one of them is X it is not covered and adds $16, making $55.

10.note: Starter is $39 plus 7 extra profiles at $5, which is $74, but it allows only one user. Professional is $59 plus 5 extra at $5, which is $84, with two seats. X is extra either way.

30.note: Starter is $39 plus 27 extra profiles at $5, which is $174 for a single user; Professional is $59 plus 25 extra, which is $184 with a three-user ceiling. Suite is quote-only and the page mentions bulk discounts, so a buyer this size may pay less.

networks.value: Facebook, Instagram including Reels and Stories, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Google Business Profile, YouTube including Shorts, and X. X is a paid add-on and Instagram publishing needs a business or creator account

api.value: No public API: the support centre answers that question with no, and points to webhooks on Suite, Zapier, and an ICS calendar feed instead

mcp.value: No MCP server is mentioned on CoSchedule's own site; the integrations named are webhooks, Zapier and calendar sync

ai.value: AI assistants for social, campaigns and projects, listed as unlimited on all paid plans, with a prompt library, AI image generation and AI alt tags. You can choose the model behind them: OpenAI, Anthropic, or Microsoft Copilot where the organisation licenses it

teams.value: Starter is a single user with no approvals. Professional includes 2 seats up to 3 users at $29 each beyond that, and adds roles, social message approvals, read-only calendar sharing and internal discussions. Suite adds custom permissions, guest access and SSO
